## Orientation

Worktree: `/home/andrewyin/se-workflow--journal-view` (branch `phase/journal-view`). Code writes only under this worktree. Do not edit `.artifacts/`. Do not call `adaptive-artifacts`. Concurrent wave mate `journal-panel` owns the EffortPane kind panel; you own `JournalScreen`, `RecordDetailScreen`, filter, `J`/`a`/`o` bindings. Model loaders (`load_journal`, `journal_scope`, `ordered`) already exist from journal-model — extend `dashboard/journal.py` for screens without rewriting those loaders unless required. Reuse `pager_command` from spec-view. Do not edit EffortPane kind panel.

### Requirements (quoted)

R1: `J` on the main screen opens a Journal screen for the selected phase, or for the whole effort on All phases. `a` toggles between the phase and the whole effort. Esc returns to the main screen.
R5: Enter on a row opens a detail screen with the record's type, subject, payload fields, and full body. Enter on a linked task opens its task detail. `o` opens the shown record or the whole list in the pager as in spec-view.
R6: The `/` filter on the Journal matches subject and text.

### Design Invariants

Only repair and evaluate efforts pay for journal loading on the main snapshot. The journal screen loads on open and reloads on store change like the other detail screens. Record text is shown as stored.

### Design Assumptions

Task-scoped journal records use the task slug as `subject` and carry `payload.effort`, as kinds-and-focus.md requires. Assignment bodies have an `## Orientation` section and amendments a `## Correction` section, as the contract requires.

### Decisions

- journal-screen: A Journal screen opened with J from the main screen, scoped to the selected phase, with a toggling the whole effort
- journal-order: Open items first (open questions, findings that need a human, observations with no finding), then every other item newest first
- journal-types: The journal shows failed attempts (marked don't retry), investigation observations, findings, continuity questions, and assignment amendments
